title: Practice 2: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Do you like music from the 70's?
exercises.why: The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать — я думаю, ты думаешь … они думают; слушать; спрашивать. The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation: я лежу, ты лежишь … они лежат. The verbs писать and жить belong to the first "Е" type of conjugation, but do not follow exactly the pattern: я пишу, ты пишешь … они пишут; я живу, ты живёшь … они живут. The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. The verbs сидеть and видеть belong to the 2nd "И" type of conjugation. Notice that the consonant д changes into ж in the first person… — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
